game_title: Truth Table Tiles – Coral Reef Shallows Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows, reef shallows: the harbor master must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Truth Table Tiles: Fill in truth-table tiles for and/or/not to light the correct path.
theme: Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows: reef shallows
core_gameplay_loop: In Coral Reef Shallows, repeat each round: Fill in truth-table tiles for and/or/not to light the correct path. Each round, smugglers strike the ship's hull, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the table_score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ship's hull from smugglers in Coral Reef Shallows: keep the table_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: table_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 9 (extended tier): Truth Table Tiles
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
